cultural.vision_reason: Loose trade beads (glass, shell) collected from various Somali coastal sites, likely archaeological/trade material rather than assembled jewelry, but plausible as objects used/traded within the region.

physical.title: bead
physical.summary: Series of small brown envelopes containing samples of (trade?) beads associated with Somalia (?); made of glass, shell; envelope 1) set of 31 beads, labelled "cane beads from 7 sites - one white, green, pink, blue, yellow, a copper glass...with sites further south in Africa AU BARE yellow are extremely similar to beads from Kuala Selinsing in the Malay Peninsular - might be quite early, similar beads associated with 6th and 8th c"; 2) 2 beads labelled "trade beads AMUD"; 3) empty envelope labelled "SHEIKH BARKAB"; 3a) 2 beads, labelled "Shiekh Barkab"; 3b) 10 beads, labelled "2 rock crystal-hexagonal barrel the rest cornelian similar type to Roman-Egyptian not like African beads. DERBILE"; 4a) 6 beads labelled "SHEIKH BARKAB"; 4b) 56 beads, labelled "11 sites Blue not early DERBIGA ADAD"; 5) 5 beads, labelled "3 Typical native made round cornelian AU BARE"; 6) empty, labelled "shell probably Ostich small flat DERBIGA ADAD"; 7) 1 bead, labelled "chrystal round typical native MUSA HASSAM"; 8) 7 beads, labelled "type see Lums[?] trade card SHEIKH BARKAB"; 10) 2 beads, labelled "Cobalt glass ring Bechnanaland Marluna land similar valuable beads had a high cash value SHEIKH BARKAB probably old trade beads"; 11a) 3 beads, labelled "old trade beads SHEIKH BARKAB"; 11b) empty, labelled "ABASA"; 12) 4 blue beads, 3 red beads, labelled "made continuously since 2nd c SHEIKH BARKAB"; 13) 1 bead, labelled "natural product DERBIGA ADAD"; 14) 2 white beads, 1 yellow bead, labelled "DERBIGA ADAD"; envelope with no number containing 4 beads, labelled "No Loc"; plastic bag containing fragment; plastic bag containing 1 red bead; plastic bag containing 2 blue beads and 7 shell beads.
